use ocx_oci::OciIdentifier;

fn qualified(value: &str) -> ocx_oci::OciIdentifier {
    ocx_oci::OciIdentifier::parse_target(value, "ocx.sh").unwrap()
}

fn imported(package: &ocx_oci::Identifier) -> OciIdentifier {
    OciIdentifier::passthrough(package)
}

fn pointer(packages: &[ocx_oci::Identifier]) -> Vec<OciIdentifier> {
    packages.iter().map(OciIdentifier::passthrough).collect()
}

fn in_macro() -> Vec<OciIdentifier> {
    vec![OciIdentifier::from_parts("tool", "ghcr.io")]
}

fn routed(location: OciIdentifier, package: &ocx_oci::Identifier) -> OciIdentifier {
    location.at_version_of(package)
}

#[cfg(test)]
fn test_only() -> OciIdentifier {
    OciIdentifier::parse_repository_pointer("oci://ghcr.io/tool").unwrap()
}

fn qualified_self(package: &ocx_oci::Identifier) -> OciIdentifier {
    <OciIdentifier>::passthrough(package)
}

impl OciIdentifier {
    fn self_in_impl(package: &ocx_oci::Identifier) -> Self {
        Self::passthrough(package)
    }
}

impl Other {
    fn self_elsewhere() -> Self {
        Self::passthrough()
    }
}

fn minting_method(raw: &Identifier) -> OciIdentifier {
    raw.as_target("ocx.sh").unwrap()
}

fn minting_method_in_macro(raw: &Identifier) -> Vec<OciIdentifier> {
    vec![raw.as_target("ocx.sh").unwrap()]
}
